Topics covered in this PDF

BEGAE-182 (English Communication Skills) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Role of silence in communication, subvocalising, intonation, creative reading, macro functions of communication, verbal versus non-verbal communication, register and jargon
  • Group discussions, formal versus informal communication, 5-minute presentation topics (AI in education, climate change), group discussion turns, a formal complaint letter, meeting etiquettes, barriers in communication

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Assignment July, 2026 and January, 2027 sessions, based on Blocks 1 to 4, maximum marks 100, answer all questions. Q1 short notes on any four of five (5 x 4 = 20). Q2 differentiate between any four pairs (5 x 4 = 20). Q3 a 5-minute presentation on either of two topics (10). Q4 a group discussion (10). Q5 a formal complaint letter (10). Q6 meeting etiquettes (10). Q7 barriers in communication (20). The PDF solves all five short-note topics, all four pairs and both presentation topics, which is more than the "any four" or "any one" the cover asks for

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

How to use the solved PDF properly

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • First read your official assignment paper and choose the questions you must answer
  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
